scope: Local action selection among lateral candidate lines, with scenario-stated blocked regions. Not minimum-time optimisation, not perception, not swept-body collision checking.

qml_controls.method: Actual QML controls, bindings and QQuickWindow captures
scenario_checks: decision panel and blockage geometry hidden with a clear corridor
Block lane states one blockage and draws it
the car chooses a line left of it without braking, and the reason names the blockage
rejected alternatives are drawn beside the chosen line
the car actually moves left of the reference line
Block track leaves no clear line, shows BLOCKED and holds the car below its blocked-line speed
Clear removes the blockage and hides the decision panel

closed_loop_runs.note: Same configuration, track and start. Only the stated blockage differs. One preset and one geometry; not a general claim.

recording_contract.decision_is_not_recorded: Schema 1 stores neither the alternatives nor the choice; replay says so rather than recomputing one.

measured_planning_cost.note: Host measurement only. The simulation is not wall-clock bound, so no result depends on it, but this is not real-time headroom.
measured_planning_cost.dominant_cost: project() is linear in track samples and is called at every predicted control point

limitations: selects among feasible lines; does not solve for a fastest line
offsets do not re-derive curvature speed limits for the shifted line
blocked regions are scenario ground truth; no detection, classification or sensor model
sampled rectangular contact test, not continuous swept-body collision checking
achieved stopping clearance 0.22 m against a 1.0 m planned margin
no tire slip, wheel locking, ABS or mass sensitivity
16 ms blocked decision against a 20 ms control period
